lineage.reason_for_v2: Exhausting the full closed-event archive is neither operationally bounded nor required for lower-bound discovery. v2 converts pagination limits into explicit truncation telemetry rather than treating archive non-exhaustion as execution failure.

purpose: Discover lower-bound candidate coverage for the ten frozen IAS families using official public Polymarket metadata, without reading ARGOS performance or realized linked-asset returns and without claiming population completeness.
compatibility_note: keyset_max_pages=200 is retained only because the unchanged base runner passes one generic max_pages argument; the v2 wrapper overrides broad routes to 100 and targeted routes to 200 and records actual telemetry.

bounded_pagination_semantics.broad: Context/lower-bound discovery only. Reaching 100 pages with a remaining cursor records truncated=true and continues; it never proves archive completeness or family absence.
bounded_pagination_semantics.targeted_keyset: Each frozen title/tag/series route is capped at 200 pages. Remaining cursor records truncated=true; returned unique events are a lower bound.
bounded_pagination_semantics.public_search: Capped at 20 pages per frozen query. hasMore after the bound records truncated=true; returned events/tags are a lower bound.
bounded_pagination_semantics.series: Capped at 20 pages. A full last page records truncated=true; matched series are a lower bound.

candidate_semantics: Discovery candidates only. A targeted-query hit or structural text-classifier hit can nominate a family; manual semantic validation is mandatory before feasibility gates or IAS scoring.
multi_family_semantics: A raw event may be nominated to multiple families; later manual validation must resolve inclusion without changing the frozen taxonomy or query dictionary.
forbidden_inputs: realized linked-asset returns used to choose families
allowed_inputs: structural linked-asset mapping defined before outcomes
no_scoring_rule: This run MUST NOT calculate IAS points, SMAA ranks, F1-F9 pass/fail, or select a W3 family.
missing_semantics: Low/zero discovery means FEASIBILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, never IAS=0 or family absence.
freeze_rule: Any substantive change after v2.0 candidate counts are opened requires a new discovery protocol version and remains auditable separately.
